ns2:course.label: The Basics of Business
ns2:course.description: Business principles related to managing a veterinary practice including economics, negotiations, finance, communication and interpersonal skills, accounting, and management. 1 graduate hour. 1 professional hour. Prerequisite: Third year standing in the veterinary curriculum or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 1 graduate hour. 1 professional hour. Prerequisite: Third year standing in the veterinary curriculum or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Third Year class standing. Restricted to VetMed - Urbana-Champaign.
